title: Neuestar H0 adjudication record
description: Append-only machine-readable adjudication of a raw H0 record. The raw observation and the machine interpretation at capture time are immutable; when adversarial or later evidence overrides a machine verdict, the override is recorded here as an adjudication record chained to the raw record and its evidence manifest by SHA-256, never by editing the raw record.

raw_record_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the raw H0 record file being adjudicated.

raw_machine_verdict.description: The verdict the machine record reported at capture time (immutable).

adjudicated_verdict.description: The accepted verdict after review of all evidence (append-only override).

evidence_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the sorted 'path sha256' lines of the evidence manifest that drove the adjudication.

failing_observation.description: The exact adversarial observation that failed the gate, as booleans.
